description:
Scope / ownership: tests only for lib/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing.ex lines 37, 42, 51, 60, 76, 101, 188, 189, 194. Exclusive test path to ADD: test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs. No production, documentation, support or existing test edits. The module's @moduledoc assigns it BO Person routing construction/display/lookup; no operation changes. Action reuse assessment: not applicable (tests exercise existing PersonRouting -> AgentRouting/IncomingMessageRouting and NodeRouter Event contracts; no new operation, Action, tool, workflow step, consumer, or side effects). Existing success integration tests: test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/people_live_test.exs lines 787-950 cover persisted global, provider, retrieval and mailbox selections; do not duplicate their broad UI journey. No new feature E2E: coverage-only tests for existing UI helper branches; no changed journey or UX approval requirement.

Tests to add before any implementation (there is no planned production implementation): use Zaq.DataCase, async: true, and alias PersonRouting, Person, PersonChannel, AgentRouting, ChannelConfig, RetrievalChannel, IncomingMessageRouting. Prefer no DB fixtures for nil/fallback/invalid input; for persisted-write negative assertions use a unique person created by People.create_person/1 with unique email/full_name, only if needed. One entry per choice map prevents Enum/map traversal-order dependence. Exact scenarios / observable assertions:
1. line 42: person_global_agent_value(nil) == "". line 51: person_provider_agent_value(nil, %ChannelConfig{id: 1}) == "". line 60: person_retrieval_agent_value(nil, %RetrievalChannel{id: 1}) == "". line 76: person_topic_agent_value(nil, %ChannelConfig{id: 1}, "INBOX") == "". These exercise nil scope fallbacks without DB queries or authorization assumptions; nil never implies a routing grant.
2. line 101: person_channel_routing_configs(nil) == [] and optionally non-PersonChannel %{} == []; assert no config lookup-dependent data. Use a %PersonChannel{platform: nonmatching_platform} separately only if checking actual config selection, not needed for this fallback.
3. lines 188, 194, 37: call maybe_persist_channel_routing_rules(person.id, %{"provider_agent_ids" => %{"not-an-id" => AgentRouting.none_value()}}). Sentinel passes choice validation, strict config-ID parsing fails with :error, reducing via line 188 to {:error, :error}, propagating through 194 and public line 37. Assert exact returned error and IncomingMessageRouting.get_rule(%{person_id: person.id}) == nil (no write), optionally check absence at known provider scope if a real config fixture is used. No NodeRouter dispatch on this validation failure. A second boundary example with one invalid agent choice for a valid numeric config key should return {:error, :invalid_agent}; a malformed retrieval channel ID or nonexistent ID must return {:error, :invalid_retrieval_channel}; a malformed topic config ID must return {:error, :invalid_topic_rule}. Assert precise errors and no persistence, without changing production semantics. Use one failing map per call, no mixed valid/invalid ordering assumption.
4. line 189: UNREACHABLE via public API under current callbacks. reduce_choice_map/2 is private; AgentRouting.validate_choice/1 returns only {:ok, choice} or {:error, reason}. provider builder returns {:ok, rule} or parse error :error; retrieval builder converts every invalid result to {:error, :invalid_retrieval_channel}; topic builder returns {:ok, rule}. The wildcard clause requires a non-tuple result from validate_choice or build_rule, which no public input can cause. Do not mock internal functions, add test-only hooks, or claim full coverage. Document line 189 as an explicit coverage exception; if future production changes create a real third return shape, then test it via public API, or separately propose a production simplification after approval.

Fixtures/helpers/mocks/isolation: reuse People.create_person/1 and existing PeopleLiveTest fixture patterns only where persistence assertions require them; do not import its private helpers or duplicate agent/config fixture setup. Real Engine context and Repo where used; no mock or new seam, no app-env/global Mox mutation, no network, no sleep/polling. DataCase SQL Sandbox keeps optional DB tests isolated and async safe. For rejected writes assert returned error and unchanged persisted scope; for pure fallbacks assert exact strings/lists. Property assessment: these are finite guard/branch examples, not broad combinatorial or invariant logic; a generated property would add less confidence. If scope is later broadened to arbitrary malformed choice-map keys, add a bounded StreamData property asserting rejection never persists, alongside concrete examples.

Validation when implemented (not during this planning task): isolated mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/system/person_routing_test.exs, then mix q through Context Mode, check fresh coverage report per WORKFLOW_AGENT Phase 6 only after approved implementation review, record line-189 exception and measured results; final mix precommit through Context Mode before final human approval. Do not weaken assertions; investigate failures before completion. Documentation changes: none; issue notes carry exception and validation evidence. Dependency graph: single root issue, no edges; no implementation until assigned/approved.
